title: On embeddings of rings into their canonical modules
summary: We study embeddings of Cohen--Macaulay local rings into their canonical modules such that the quotient of the cokernel by a regular sequence has the residue field as a direct summand. Motivated by almost Gorenstein rings, we prove an Ext-vanishing criterion for finite projective dimension, which implies G-regularity and the generalized Auslander--Reiten condition. We characterize this summand condition for one-dimensional fiber products and numerical semigroup rings.
